# Individual Card Design

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Individual Card Design

Before creating the full layout, let's start by building a single blog card. Each card will include essential elements to display content in a structured and engaging way.

![Designing a card element for blogs](data:image/png;base64,)

We have added new elements to our card. Each blog card will now contain the following elements:

1. An image (to visually represent the blog topic)
2. A title (the main subject of the blog)
3. A source (indicating where the blog was published, e.g., freeCodeCamp)
4. A "Read" button (to encourage interaction and easy access)

This setup will make each card visually appealing and easy for users to navigate.
